_comment: Mutations that remove the guarantees added by the daily-loss gate fix
(2026-10-24): the gate's NUMERATOR must be the wallet's day PnL, and
its DENOMINATOR must never be invented by a read.
N1 is the ENTRY leg not being booked -- the exact origin/main defect.
The entry fill is charged a commission and the wallet is debited, but
nothing books it to the risk manager, so the gate's numerator is short
by every entry commission ever paid:
RM loss = DB loss - entry commissions.
The daily-loss gate then reads LOW and under-trips (a true 8.2767% was
published as 6.17% against a 5% threshold).
N2 is a fill booking the GROSS instead of the NET, so the wallet and the
risk manager are told different numbers for the same fill.
N3 is the forced close not booking its leg at all. The forced close does
not go through `place_order`, so it has to book its own leg where its
money moved -- and it must do so BEFORE the notifier, which flips the
position to CLOSING (an exit leg is only booked while the position is
still OPEN).
N4 is the paper balance READ creating a $10,000 wallet for an account
that has none. The risk manager then stamps that $10,000 as the day's
opening balance: 5% of $10,000 is $500 of tolerated loss against 5% of a
real ~$756.28 base = $37.81 -- a 13.2x disarm of the gate.
N5 and N6 are the two GET routes creating a wallet. A read must never
create money.
N7 is the destructive wallet reset no longer requiring an explicit
`reset=True`, so any caller could wipe a live balance.
N8 is the startup re-derive writing the MID-DAY balance as today's
opening balance. The live balance already contains today's PnL, so
restating the day's loss against it measures the loss against a
denominator that contains it -- it reads LOW, which is the same shape of
defect as a base captured on another day. The base must stay UNKNOWN and
the gate must fail CLOSED instead.
N9 is the ONE opening-balance writer overwriting a base that already
belongs to today. Today's opening balance is a fact about the start of
the day.
N10 is the restore not invalidating an UNBACKED base that was written
BEFORE it. A base captured while the persisted state could not be READ
is a guess -- the balance may already contain today's PnL -- so a later
payload that refuses the persisted base must refuse the guess too.
N11 is the EXIT leg being booked TWICE. Twice would make the daily-loss
gate over-trip on a loss the account did not make. It is here because a
test that never exercises the exit leg cannot catch it: the SL/TP exit
only happens when the market price falls through the stop, so a test
that rests a stop and leaves the market still never triggers it.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/daily_loss_gate_numerator_and_wallet_base.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.
N12 is the F3 hole: a process whose FIRST observation of the day is not
a UTC day transition capturing the live (MID-DAY) balance as today's
opening balance. An empty `last_known_day_str` means 'this process has
no known day yet', not 'the day changed': the live balance already
contains today's PnL, so installing it measures the day's loss against
a denominator that contains it. The review panel measured a gate
reading 0.0000% against a true 4.4188% loss, with trading ALLOWED.
N13 is a previous-day payload NOT invalidating an unbacked base that is
already stamped with today's day key. A payload from a previous day
proves the account has traded, so today's opening balance is UNKNOWN
and an unbacked base stamped today must be dropped -- including the
guess captured while the persisted state could not be read.
N16 is every opening balance counting as unbacked, so a base this
process VOUCHED for (captured at a genuine UTC rollover, captured for
an account that had never traded, restored from a payload that says it
belongs to today) is thrown away when a later payload arrives. That
blocks a healthy account for the rest of the day for no gain
N14 is the finalization counting the FUNDING a second time. The funding
is reported to the risk manager the moment it is charged (the wallet
moved then), and it is part of the position's booked PnL, so the close
would count it twice without subtracting the already-reported part.
N15 is the funding never being reported to the risk manager at all: the
wallet is debited and the gate never hears about it, so the daily-loss
guard cannot see a loss that has already happened.

mutations.label: N1: the ENTRY leg is not booked to the risk manager
N2: a fill books the GROSS instead of the NET
N3: the forced close does not book its leg
mutations.needle:
await self._book_fill_pnl_to_position(
            symbol,
            net_realized_pnl(realized_pnl, commission),
            is_entry_leg=False,
        )
mutations.replace: pass  # MUTATED: the forced close never books its leg

mutations.label: N4: a balance READ creates a $10,000 wallet
mutations.needle:
logger.error(
                    f"[PaperExecutor] No paper wallet exists for user "
                    f"{self.user_id}. The balance is UNKNOWN and no wallet is "
                    "created by a read. The risk manager will fail closed "
                    "until a wallet exists (POST /api/v1/account/paper/reset "
                    "creates one)."
                )
                return None

mutations.label: N5: the portfolio GET creates a wallet
mutations.needle:
wallet_assets = await crud.get_paper_wallet(db, user_id=current_user.id)
        # A READ NEVER CREATES MONEY. A wallet-less account is reported with
mutations.replace:
wallet_assets = await crud.get_paper_wallet(db, user_id=current_user.id)
        if not wallet_assets:
            wallet_assets = await crud.init_or_reset_paper_wallet(
                db, user_id=current_user.id
            )
            await db.commit()
        # A READ NEVER CREATES MONEY. A wallet-less account is reported with

mutations.label: N6: the paper account GET creates a wallet
mutations.needle:
wallet_assets = await crud.get_paper_wallet(db, user_id=current_user.id)

    return {"data": wallet_assets}

mutations.label: N7: the destructive wallet reset no longer needs an explicit opt-in
mutations.needle:
if reset:
        # Delete existing wallet entries for the user
mutations.replace:
if True:
        # Delete existing wallet entries for the user

mutations.label: N8: the startup re-derive writes a mid-day balance as today's opening balance
mutations.needle:
# Leave the base unusable: a base captured on another day must
                # not linger where something could read it, and an absent
                # base must not be filled with a guess. `_daily_loss_base_is_usable()`
                # therefore returns False and `_check_risk_limits()` closes the
                # gate with `RISK_GUARD_BASE_UNKNOWN_REASON`.
                self.stats.start_of_day_balance = 0.0
                self.stats.start_of_day_day_str = ""

mutations.label: N9: the opening-balance writer overwrites a base that already belongs to today
N11: the SL/TP exit leg is DOUBLE-booked
N10: the restore does not invalidate an UNBACKED base written before it
N12: a first observation (no known previous day) captures the mid-day balance as today's base
N13: a previous-day payload does not invalidate an UNBACKED base stamped today
N16: every opening balance counts as unbacked, so a vouched-for base is dropped
mutations.needle:
provenance = getattr(self, "_start_of_day_base_provenance", None)
        return provenance is None or provenance == "unknown_history"
mutations.replace: return True  # MUTATED: every base counts as unbacked

mutations.label: N14: the finalization counts the funding a second time
N15: the funding is never reported to the risk manager
mutations.replace: pass  # MUTATED: the funding is never reported
